# PjotrCasteel Open Source

> Independent open-source .NET tools for making difficult software behavior explicit.

Canonical creator hub: https://pjotrcasteel.github.io/
GitHub: https://github.com/pjotrcasteel
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/profiles/PjotrCasteel

## Product map

### Causalia

Promise: Explore what can happen.

Deterministic simulation testing for concurrent and distributed .NET software.

- Website: https://pjotrcasteel.github.io/Causalia/
- Source: https://github.com/pjotrcasteel/Causalia
- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Causalia

### Forge

Promise: Plan what should happen.

Strongly typed primitives for semantic differences, desired-state reconciliation and explicit transition planning.

- Website: https://pjotrcasteel.github.io/Forge/
- Source: https://github.com/pjotrcasteel/Forge
- Production story: https://pjotrcasteel.github.io/Forge/service-provisioning.html
- Forge.Delta: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Forge.Delta
- Forge.Sync: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Forge.Sync
- Forge.Parse: reserved/planned family identity; it belongs inside the Forge product family.

### GORM

Promise: Model how things connect.

Strongly typed graph persistence for .NET, centered on nodes, relationships, traversal, temporal history and explicit SQL Server Graph behavior.

- Website: https://pjotrcasteel.github.io/GORM/
- Source: https://github.com/pjotrcasteel/GORM
- Status: public product surface live; implementation source migration and NuGet publication intentionally deferred.

## Shared engineering DNA

- typed over stringly;
- evidence before claims;
- explicit product boundaries;
- deterministic explanations;
- independent products rather than an umbrella framework;
- product-specific visual identities;
- machine-readable documentation where useful.

Canonical Design DNA: https://pjotrcasteel.github.io/CREATOR_DESIGN_DNA.md
